scope: Native Commit menu/current-action keyboard dispatch, reverse category checks, issue-to-message focus and owned sign-off identity lookup
implementation: Window-scoped native Commit root with current/source three-action submenu, selection, message/history/revision insertion, sign-off, options, patch, refresh and Help commands; original icons and checked/enabled states.

Control-Return invokes the current remembered action, with Command-Return retained. Dedicated Command-Option-Return ReCommit and Command-Shift-Return Commit & Push adapt Windows Alt mnemonics without consuming macOS Option typing.
F5 uses the same owner scope and recognizes its native key code; busy/background/sheet/retired and duplicate guards remain authoritative.
Owned menus repair replacement idempotently, defer reconstruction during nested tracking, and reject detached/retained items through installation epochs.
Shift-check reverses only the matching category; None/All invert, checkbox unchecking clears matching conflicted rows, while staging still excludes conflicted paths.
Issue-field Return requests existing message focus. Main-menu message insertion focuses the actual editor.

Sign-off identity lookup uses existing cancellable Commit operation lifetime; Close requests cancellation and drains ownership, retry works, forced retirement refuses late message/focus/error updates.

core.reason: Native menu, focus, selection routing and owned use of existing Core operations.

build_repairs: Menu needed internal access to the formerly private message editor; it is now named CommitMessageTextView. Merged command installation into the pre-existing key-window callback, retaining partial-panel/hint behavior.
A broad class rename accidentally changed ProjectMessageTextView; restored the actual superclass before successful builds.
Final pre-native review removed the unscoped F5 fallback and preserved conflict-row checkbox unchecking; only an incremental native build was needed.

native.compile_reason: Fixture referenced private loadedMessage; use public readiness and validate enabled current-action state instead. No receiver ran in this attempt.
native.initial_reason: Fixture treated windowShouldClose as a passive probe; Commit actually requests cancellation. It now asserts unchanged message/cancellation and retries sign-off successfully.
new_coverage: Native command icons/source action labels and remembered current action
Owned sign-off read, duplicate/Close cancellation/retry and late-retirement refusal
Actual Control-Return produces exactly one checked-file commit and runs remembered ReCommit
native.fixture_update: Retained hidden staging F5 check injects its intended key-window/menu scope before sending the actual native key event; status/index/row assertions unchanged.

remaining: Physical Shift-click and main-menu gestures, issue-field Return, keyboard layouts and VoiceOver
